bypass_paths.path: Direct request to the invoice service port 8443
bypass_paths.evidence: Network policy admits only the gateway as a source; fixture EXGW-N03
Routes removed from the gateway; fixture EXGW-N04
Served through the same filter chain, so the enforcement points above apply; fixture EXGW-N05
Batch job with no agent-facing route; excluded in unsupported_forms

unsupported_forms: Telling agents apart when they share one account, or enforcement on an unchanged server: only dedicated accounts behind this gateway are claimed
Employee delegation, and nested-group semantics of the directory: no delegation exists, and only the groups lookup in freshness is claimed
Any route other than the two in protected_routes, including every write operation: not listed, so not claimed
The nightly CSV export job: excluded by its out_of_claim control in bypass_paths

freshness.source: Enrollment registry (agent and key binding status)

change_feed.mechanism: Directory change-tracking cookie polled every 30 seconds; a changed group evicts the cached membership

residual_limits: Post-read: invoice data already returned to the agent is not recalled by a later revocation, and no egress or data-use control is claimed; disclosed here with no bound

Revocation propagation: removal from a directory group reaches the gateway within the 30 s status bound of the groups lookup; the other three sources are checked fresh for each evaluation within each source's own consistency; an operation already executed is not undone by revoking its receipt
